SuperAdmin.title: SuperAdmin
SuperAdmin.description: Represents the Super Admin of the ParkX platform.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Super Admin entity.

email.description: Email address of the Super Admin.

firstName.description: First name of the Super Admin.

lastName.description: Last name of the Super Admin.

platformFeePercentage.description: The percentage fee charged by the platform on vendor transactions.

Vendor.title: Vendor
Vendor.description: Represents a vendor (parking lot business) on the ParkX platform.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Vendor entity.

email.description: Contact email address for the vendor.

isPrivileged.description: Grants the vendor special, elevated permissions.

stripeCustomerId.description: The ID of the customer object in Stripe.

stripeAccountId.description: The ID of the Stripe Connected Account for payouts.

stripeSubscriptionId.description: The ID of the active Stripe subscription.

spotLimitIncreaseRequested.description: Flag indicating if the vendor has requested an increase in their spot limit.

spotLimitRequestDate.description: The date the vendor requested a spot limit increase.

spotLimit.description: Maximum number of parking spots allowed for the vendor.

status.description: Status of the vendor (e.g., Pending Agreement, Active, Trial, Paused, Canceled).

trialOffered.description: Indicates if a 30-day trial was offered upon creation.

trialEnds.description: The date the vendor's trial period ends.

logoUrl.description: URL of the vendor's company logo.

onboardingLink.description: A one-time URL for the vendor to complete Stripe onboarding.

EndUser.title: EndUser
EndUser.description: Represents an end-user (customer) of a vendor.

id.description: Unique identifier for the End User entity.

assignedSpotIds.description: An array of ParkingSpot IDs assigned to this user.

cancellationRequested.description: Flag indicating if the user has requested to cancel their spot.

cancellationRequestDate.description: The date the user requested cancellation.

truckParkingSpots.description: Number of truck parking spots assigned to the user.

isRecurringPayment.description: Flag indicating if the user is on a recurring payment plan.

truckCompanyName.description: The name of the user's truck company.

truckUnitNumber.description: The unit number of the user's truck.

vinNumber.description: The VIN of the user's truck.

tagNumber.description: The license plate or tag number of the user's truck.

waiverSigned.description: Indicates if the user has signed the liability waiver.

waiverSignedDate.description: The date the user signed the waiver.

profileComplete.description: Indicates if the user has completed the initial profile setup.

vehicleYear.description: The year of the user's vehicle.

vehicleMake.description: The make of the user's vehicle.

vehicleModel.description: The model of the user's vehicle.

licensePlate.description: The license plate of the user's vehicle.

trailerPlate.description: The trailer plate of the user's vehicle, if any.

acknowledgedAnnouncements.description: A list of VendorAnnouncement IDs that the user has acknowledged.

ParkingSpot.title: ParkingSpot
ParkingSpot.description: Represents a parking spot within a vendor's parking lot.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Parking Spot entity.

name.description: Name or identifier of the parking spot (e.g., 'A1', 'Spot 10').

isAvailable.description: Indicates whether the parking spot is currently available.

userId.description: The ID of the EndUser assigned to this spot.

Message.title: Message
Message.description: Represents a single message within a conversation between an end user and their vendor.

SupportMessage.title: SupportMessage
SupportMessage.description: Represents a single message within a support conversation between a vendor and a super admin.

SmsLog.title: SmsLog
SmsLog.description: Records an SMS message sent to a user.

body.description: The content of the SMS message.

status.description: The sending status of the message.

error.description: Any error message if the send failed.

sentAt.description: The timestamp when the message was sent.

Transaction.title: Transaction
Transaction.description: Represents a financial transaction processed by Stripe, synced to Firestore.

amount.description: Amount in the smallest currency unit (e.g., cents).

vendorId.description: The ID of the vendor who received the payment.

customerEmail.description: Email of the customer who made the payment.

fee.description: The fee amount charged by Stripe, in the smallest currency unit.

net.description: The net amount received after fees, in the smallest currency unit.

amountRefunded.description: The amount refunded, in the smallest currency unit.

refundedAt.description: Unix timestamp of when the refund was processed.

VendorInvoice.title: VendorInvoice
VendorInvoice.description: Represents an invoice for a vendor, covering subscriptions and additional services.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Vendor Invoice.

vendorId.description: The ID of the vendor this invoice belongs to.

vendorName.description: The name of the vendor (denormalized for display).

amount.description: The total amount of the invoice.

dueDate.description: The date the invoice is due.

status.description: The current status of the invoice (e.g., Pending, Paid, Overdue).

notes.description: Additional notes or line items for the invoice.

stripeInvoicePdfUrl.description: The URL for the downloadable PDF of the invoice from Stripe.

UserInvoice.title: UserInvoice
UserInvoice.description: Represents an invoice from a Vendor to an End User for parking services.

id.description: Unique identifier for the User Invoice.

vendorId.description: The ID of the vendor who issued this invoice.

userId.description: The ID of the user this invoice belongs to.

userName.description: The name of the user (denormalized for display).

amount.description: The total amount of the invoice.

dueDate.description: The date the invoice is due.

status.description: The current status of the invoice (e.g., Pending, Paid, Overdue).

notes.description: Additional notes or line items for the invoice.

stripeCheckoutSessionId.description: The ID of the Stripe Checkout Session used to pay this invoice.

stripeReceiptUrl.description: The URL for the downloadable receipt from Stripe.

UserDocument.title: UserDocument
UserDocument.description: Represents a document associated with a user, such as a signed waiver or a spot change record.

name.description: The name of the document, e.g., 'Parking Agreement' or 'Spot Change Record'.

content.description: The full text or content of the document.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the document was created.

VendorDocument.title: VendorDocument
VendorDocument.description: Represents a document associated with a vendor, such as a signed master agreement.

Payout.title: Payout
Payout.description: Represents a payout from Stripe to a vendor's bank account.

amount.description: Amount in the smallest currency unit.

Notification.title: Notification
Notification.description: Represents a notification for an end-user.

PlatformNotification.title: PlatformNotification
PlatformNotification.description: Represents a platform-level notification for a Super Admin.

VendorNotification.title: VendorNotification
VendorNotification.description: Represents a notification for a Vendor Admin.

Announcement.title: Announcement
Announcement.description: A global announcement or blog post made by the Super Admin.

VendorAnnouncement.title: VendorAnnouncement
VendorAnnouncement.description: An announcement made by a Vendor to all their End Users.

isPrivileged.description: Grants the vendor special, elevated permissions to view data across all vendors.

firestore.reasoning: The Firestore structure has been updated to use a top-level `/users` collection for End Users. This is a best practice that ensures fast, scalable, and secure user role lookups during login, eliminating the need for expensive and permission-prone collection-group queries. Each user document in the `/users` collection contains a `vendorId` field to maintain its relationship with a vendor, which is used for authorization in security rules. A new sub-collection `userInvoices` has been added under `/vendors/{vendorId}` to store billing records from a vendor to their users, ensuring that a vendor can only access their own financial data. A new sub-collection 'userDocuments' has been added to store signed waivers and other documents for users, accessible by the vendor. The messaging system is refactored to use a `/users/{userId}/messages` subcollection, which is a more direct and secure pattern for 1-to-1 chats between a user and their vendor. A new `/vendors/{vendorId}/support-messages` subcollection has been added for private communication between vendors and super admins. Finally, a `vendorDocuments` subcollection is added to store important vendor-specific documents like the signed MSA. A top-level `transactions` collection is added to log all payments from Stripe. Two new collections were added for the announcement features: a top-level `/announcements` for global posts and a `/vendors/{vendorId}/announcements` subcollection for vendor-specific alerts.
